meta.title: Khaki Press — Reader study 2026
meta.description: Research readout for Khaki Press, an independent print zine: why one in three subscribers left after Issue 05, what keeps readers, price tolerance, where copies sell, limits of the study, and ranked recommendations.

slides.heading: Readers pay for the essay.
slides.lead: Why our print readers stay, from 1,186 replies. For the Issue 08 planning meeting.
slides.notes: This is a pre-read and a live deck. In the room, read the headings aloud; they carry the argument.

slides.heading: Three findings: the essay keeps readers, price does not, shops sell

cards.title: The essay drives renewal
cards.body: Readers who finish it renew at 71%, against 38% for skimmers.

cards.title: Price is not the problem
cards.body: At $11 an issue, 96% of readers would still buy.

cards.title: Shops outsell the post
cards.body: Independent shops sell 58% of every print run.

slides.heading: One in three subscribers left after Issue 05, and we needed to know why
slides.lead: Subscribers fell from 2,400 to 1,610. Issue 07 won back 370. What made people leave?

slides.heading: What we found
slides.lead: Three findings, each with its evidence.

slides.heading: Readers who finish the long essay renew at nearly twice the rate
slides.lead: Renewal rate by reading habit. Source: survey matched to renewal records, n = 1,186.

slides.quote: The essay is the reason I keep it on the shelf. Without it, Issue 05 felt like a flyer.
slides.by: Reader in Leeds, subscriber since Issue 01 · interview 14

slides.heading: Raising the price from $9 to $11 would keep 96% of readers
Independent shops sell 58% of copies, twice the share of mail
slides.lead: Share of Issue 07 copies sold, by channel. Source: distributor and Stripe records.

slides.heading: We expected price to explain the losses, but the missing essay did
slides.left:
The $2 rise in Issue 04 pushed readers out.
Post delays made renewals lapse.
slides.right:
64% of readers who left named the missing essay.
Only 9% named the price.
slides.notes: This is the slide to slow down on. The team believed the price story for six months.

rows: Price answers are stated, not observed

slides.heading: Three moves, ranked by their effect on renewals

items.label: Run a long essay in every issue
Raise the price to $11 from Issue 08

slides.notes: The ranking is by renewal effect, not revenue. The price move earns most per issue but keeps nobody.

slides.heading: Keep the long essay.
slides.lead: Commit to one in every issue from Issue 08. It prints on 6 February 2027, so the essay needs a writer by 15 December.
